== English errata comparison sources ==
Changes 6 passengers to 1 driver and 5 passengers. Same deploy -1, react, and disembark-on-loss rules. Remains unrestricted Light Transport vehicle, destiny 2, power 3, maneuver 3, landspeed 3, deploy 3 and forfeit 3. Correct PC label if moving with direct historical alias, and never mix the separately numbered Dark face.

Decipher, [https://swccg.com/wiki/images/f/fb/Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf#page=119 Glossary 2.0], November 1998, PDF page 119, Skiff. Players Committee, [https://swccg.com/wiki/images/3/3d/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=128 PC Appendix A], Appendix A, PDF page 128.
